confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'most likely the thermostat if this is a dial-controlled oven' is hedged, not definitive

rationale: The assistant used the customer's evidence (fan running, flattened seal, erratic neon, wobbly knob) and gave safe checks, with no DIY panel removal and no part purchase. It escalated to an engineer with a useful list of things to check. It leaned a little toward the thermostat and downplayed user factors such as preheating habits, which it never asked about. It also dropped the cheap thermometer suggestion after the customer said they had none, when buying one would have been a sensible step before paying for an engineer. Escalation is reasonable given the intermittent control fault, though.</br>
